exposure: 1% ethylenethiourea (125mg/kg) by gavage on gestational day 11
cohort: The study included 24 pregnant rats, randomly divided into an experimental group and a control group, with fetal rats obtained by cesarean section on gestational day 16.
finding: 111 miRNAs were up-regulated and 117 miRNAs were down-regulated in the terminal hindgut of experimental group fetal rats compared to controls, with miR-193-mediated inhibition of Hoxd13 found to be significant in rat intestinal epithelial cells.
gest_age: Fetal rats obtained on gestational day 16
